tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: Cobalt Labs (V-186) has two approved invoices, not one: INV-30444 for $3,714.45 (due 2026-11-04) and INV-51862 for $6,764.82 (due 2026-11-25). Which one should I pay by wire? Or should I pay both?

trace.question: Cobalt Labs (V-186) has two approved invoices, not one: INV-30444 for $3,714.45 (due 2026-11-04) and INV-51862 for $6,764.82 (due 2026-11-25). Which one should I pay by wire? Or should I pay both?

trace.message: Pay INV-51862, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Cobalt Labs invoice INV-51862 in full by wire: $6,764.82 from the operating account. The payment ID is PAY0001, and its status is sent and verified.

- **Which invoice:** Cobalt Labs had two approved invoices, so I asked you which one to pay. You chose INV-51862 (due 2026-11-25). I didn't pay INV-30444 ($3,714.45, due 2026-11-04) because you said it's under dispute.
- **Paid exactly once:** No payments had been sent from the operating account before this one. I also sent the wire with a unique key so a repeated request couldn't pay it twice.
- **Approval:** The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
